name: @equin/plugin-plugin-meta-relocate-reroot
description: A plugin id re-rooted through a move, as a leaf every reader of a move shares: movedPluginId (where an id lands after moving from → to) and, in a config file's text, the plugin-id half of every reorder entry key (`"<pluginId>:<id>"` in an `items` array, at any depth) located by range and re-rooted in place — what the mover, the plugin-refs locator and a backend deriving its config generation all read keys with.
